name: Library Doctor
description: A checkup for your Jellyfin library: unreadable files, missing episodes, duplicates, bad matches, missing posters, and files that will need converting.
overview: Find what's wrong with your library before it ruins movie night.

versions.changelog: 0.1.0.0: first release. A weekly checkup (or on demand) that lists files Jellyfin can't read, with a fix command for permission problems; missing episodes; duplicates; unmatched or wrongly matched titles; files your TV will need converting; and titles with no poster. Its page is in the Dashboard menu.
